component.name: Zenith
component.summary: Personal kanban board for projects and tasks
Kanban board personale per progetti e task

description.p: Zenith is a simple, personal kanban board to organize projects and their tasks in columns.
Zenith è una kanban board personale e semplice per organizzare progetti e task in colonne.
All data is kept in a single JSON file: put it in a synchronized folder (for example Nextcloud) to use the same board from several computers.
Tutti i dati stanno in un unico file JSON: mettilo in una cartella sincronizzata (per esempio Nextcloud) per usare la stessa board da più computer.
